function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — 24 patients were re-tested and appear twice in the data", "implication": "The population is defined as 'all patients in the trial', not 'all rows'. If we compute the mean over all rows, we will double-weight the 24 re-tested patients. This will bias the mean upward or downward depending on whether re-tested patients have higher or lower biomarker values. Therefore, we must deduplicate the data on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. This ensures each patient is counted once."}
function.name: note_finding
